root_cause_criterion.obligation: The second group assignment in fillDetails must index groups[] by the current groups_count value, not a hardcoded 0.

nodes.description: After both group branches execute, groups_count=2 but groups[1] is uninitialized (vulnerable) or properly written (fixed).
The id parameter from groups[1] is used in a conditional branch. MSan detects use-of-uninitialized-value here.

edges.description: The hardcoded write index (0 instead of groups_count) causes groups[1] to remain uninitialized after increment.
The uninitialized groups[1] value propagates through the harness iteration and cs_group_name dispatch to arrive as the id parameter at the sink.
